result-bfsg.title: Language review for BFSG-related projects
result-bfsg.text:
Under the German Accessibility Strengthening Act (BFSG), accessibility requirements have applied to certain products and services since June 2025. I review German-language information for clarity, structure and ease of use. Whether a specific product or service falls within the BFSG's scope is a separate legal question.

Reference: I worked on German source texts and Easy Language content for the DARP funding guide in a project involving Germany's Federal Ministry of Finance and PD – Advisers to the Public Sector.

result-website-analyse.title: Website accessibility analysis
result-website-analyse.text: I review representative pages and functions from technical and editorial perspectives. You receive a written report with specific findings, priorities and recommendations. Technical implementation is a separate step; you can give the report to a provider of your choice.

result-bitv.title: Easy Language for public authorities
result-bitv.text:
The BGG and BITV 2.0 include specific provisions on Easy Language for public bodies. I rewrite German notices, forms and web content in clear language while preserving the legal meaning. Legal review remains the responsibility of the competent legal office.

Reference: I worked on Easy Language content for the DARP funding guide in a project involving Germany's Federal Ministry of Finance and PD – Advisers to the Public Sector.

result-einfache-sprache.title: Plain Language under DIN 8581-1
result-einfache-sprache.text: Not every text needs Easy Language. Often, Plain Language is the right fit: clear structure, familiar words, precise statements and fewer follow-up questions. It can work well for customer information, HR, internal guidelines, health communication, insurance and administrative texts.

result-leichte-sprache.title: Easy Language for voluntary projects
result-leichte-sprache.text: German Easy Language is designed to help people who face barriers with standard-language texts, including people with learning difficulties, older people and people whose first language is not German. I adapt your German text for this language level.

result-verwaltung-behoerde.title: Clear texts for your authority
result-verwaltung-behoerde.text: Clear public-facing language is an established policy goal and is expressly provided for in some public-sector contexts. I revise notices, forms and brochures to help residents understand them without compromising legal precision.

result-verwaltung-agentur.title: Language support for your agency project
result-verwaltung-agentur.text:
You manage the project and client relationship. I handle the agreed language work: Easy Language or Plain Language, final editing, proofreading, translation or review of AI-generated drafts. You receive a version ready to share with your client.

Any review by a target or review group is arranged by the client. I can prepare the text and incorporate feedback within the agreed scope.

result-verwaltung-unternehmen.title: Clear corporate communication
result-verwaltung-unternehmen.text: Whether customer letters, terms and conditions or internal guidelines: clarity saves follow-up questions and builds trust. I revise your texts so that they are clear and professional.

result-ki-einzel.title: Review and revise an AI-generated text
result-ki-einzel.text:
AI-generated texts can sound generic, contain factual errors or miss your organization's style. I review and revise the text for subject-matter accuracy, language and tone.

Background: quality assurance at Jung von Matt, Goodgame Studios and InnoGames.

result-ki-laufend.title: Ongoing AI quality assurance
result-ki-laufend.text:
Do you produce AI-generated texts regularly and need ongoing quality assurance? I can review and post-edit drafts and align them with your style guide. Reporting is available by agreement.

Background: quality assurance at Jung von Matt, Goodgame Studios and InnoGames.

result-lektorat-de.title: German editing
result-lektorat-de.text: Proofreading, style and consistency. I edit your texts carefully, from blog posts to annual reports.

result-lektorat-en.title: English editing
result-lektorat-en.text: Proofreading and editing for English-language texts, informed by years of working with international teams in gaming, technology and media.

result-lektorat-beide.title: Editing in German and English
result-lektorat-beide.text: Need German and English versions to match? I edit both and keep the terminology and tone consistent.

result-unsicher.title: Not sure? Just get in touch.
result-unsicher.text: Briefly describe what you need. I will get back to you within 24 hours with an assessment and a suggestion. There is no obligation, and the assessment is free.
